facts.fact: Revises F552: Chathu files contracts bought by Ittan in a separately sewn 'Keeper's' quire marked with the hooked mark. Asha's leaf reads: 'The cold month, six years gone. Kettamala, the warden's daughter, the west stair. Buyer, the Keeper. Hand, Thirty. Lookout, Seventeen. Closed. Paid in full.' (Devan's father was warden then, F440; Devan became warden five years ago.) Devan says aloud, 'My father was warden then.'

Neela was called to Chathu's room twelve times, once before each of her own twelve contracts including Devan's. The lookout night at Kettamala came with no summons: a hand on her shoulder in the dark and a blindfold.
